scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web; wait
scripts.build: npm run build -w @msm/shared && npm run build -w @msm/node-agent && npm run build -w @msm/daemon && npm run build -w @msm/api && npm run build -w @msm/web
scripts.build:release: node scripts/esbuild-release.mjs all && npm run build -w @msm/web
scripts.prod: npm run build && npm run start:prod
scripts.prod:release: npm run build:release && npm run start:prod
